decisions.reason: As a large German machinery producer, the firm would typically give a newly launched core industrial printer several years to build adoption and recover development costs.
Although this is a narrower software add-on, it complements the firm's digital inline printing portfolio and is therefore more likely to be retained than withdrawn after only one year.
An inkjet coder for non-absorbent surfaces fits established industrial marking applications, so management would usually keep it on the market unless early demand was clearly disappointing.
